components.name: Hairline Branch Comparison Row
components.description: Flat hairline branch row showing numbered key, bold lead word, muted continuation, depth-2 SVG twigs, and probability bar.
components.css: .ds-branch-row { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; text-align: left; padding: 10px 8px; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #d3ddd4; border-bottom: 1px solid #d3ddd4; background: #fafcfa; cursor: pointer; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr) 82px; gap: 4px 12px; align-items: start; transition: background 130ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-branch-row:hover { background: rgba(24, 100, 86, 0.10); } .ds-branch-key { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 4px; background: #186456; color: #fff; font: 600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-branch-text { font: 400 16px/1.42 'Literata', Georgia, serif; color: #17231e; } .ds-rest { color: #465850; } .ds-twigs { margin-top: 5px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-twig-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f2f6f1; border: 1px solid #d3ddd4; font: 400 12.5px/1.25 'Literata', Georgia, serif; color: #17231e; } .ds-twig-chip em { font: 500 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-style: normal; color: #465850; } .ds-branch-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 5px; padding-top: 3px; } .ds-pct { font: 600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #17231e; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar { width: 70px; height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: #ebf0ea; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: #186456; border-radius: 99px; }

components.css: .ds-slider { width: 280px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #f2f6f1; border: 1px solid #d3ddd4; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-slider-lbl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; font: 500 11.5px/1.2 'Public Sans', sans-serif; color: #465850; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-slider-lbl span:last-child { text-align: right; } .ds-slider-val { font: 600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #186456; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(24,100,86,0.10); border: 1px solid #186456; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bipolar { position: relative; height: 22px; } .ds-track { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 4px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 99px; background: #b7c6b9; } .ds-zero { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 1.5px; height: 11px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #465850; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-fill { position: absolute; left: 50%; width: 30%; top: 50%; height: 4px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 99px; background: #186456; } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; left: 80%; top: 50%; width: 14px; height: 14px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: #186456; border: 2px solid #fafcfa; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.24); }

narrative.overview:
Translation Explorer treats live literary co-translation like examining pressed botanical specimens on an archival mineral-paper desk beside engraved surveying instruments. The poetry and prose stay open, legible, and undisturbed across facing folios, while every steering tool—the 2D Spectral Compass, zero-centered bipolar tone sliders, and transit-interchange branch history—lives in a disciplined right-hand instrument rail that opens on demand and never competes with the words.

The visual voice rejects generic SaaS cards, heavy drop shadows, neon glows, and stacked dashboard chrome. Surface tone shifts (celadon-vellum desk, mineral rail, crisp specimen paper) and 1px hairline rules establish clear spatial hierarchy across both Daylight Vellum light mode and Evening Botanical dark mode, while a single committed dark botanical studio bar anchors the top of the workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Open facing manuscripts separated by crisp 1px hairlines rather than nested card frames
High-legibility literary serif typography (Literata) paired with restrained geometric UI chrome (Public Sans) and tabular monospace metrics (JetBrains Mono)

Strictly semantic signal colors: spruce-teal for active steering and primary actions, amber-ochre for subtle choices, cinnabar for high-tension interpretive forks, and cobalt for bidirectional source-target line alignment
Zero-build single-file HTML/CSS/JS delivery unified across both the live FastAPI studio and standalone offline archival exports

rules.name: The Single Primary Action Rule
rules.body: Only one solid Spruce Teal CTA occupies visual dominance in the main desk at a time: Start Co-Translating while composing source text, demoted to secondary Restart once live so Step Word commands focus.

rules.name: The Semantic Ink Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar, ochre, and cobalt are reserved strictly for fork tension, subtle choice, and cross-folio line alignment—never for decorative chrome or generic buttons.

rules.name: The Prose-First Scale Rule
rules.body: Source and translation text stay at 18.5px–19.5px Literata while all surrounding controls remain compact (11.5px–13.5px sans/mono), ensuring poetry dominates the eye before chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every live metric—entropy (H), probability (%), coordinates (x, y), and slider readout (+0.6)—uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in JetBrains Mono so values never jitter horizontally during streaming or dragging.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Never stack drop-shadowed cards inside a column. Separate open workspaces with surface tone shifts and 1px hairlines.

dos: Do keep the active Source poem and live Translation canvas open and flush across a single 1px vertical hairline so both manuscripts read as a single facing spread.
Do enforce the Single Primary Action Rule—demote Start Co-Translating to secondary Restart once a session is active so Step Word is the unmistakable primary action.
Do render every bipolar axis slider from a true center zero tick (0.0 = zero colored fill) so neutral axes never falsely appear half-pulled toward the negative pole.
Do clip compass scatter dots inside the r=1.20 bezel and mix reading label colors toward var(--ink) with a var(--paper) halo so dark mode stays crisp and legible.
Do use custom stroke-1.5 inline SVGs for transport and drawer icons (↵, ¶, sliders, twigs) while preserving accessible aria-label attributes and all keyboard shortcuts.
donts: Don't wrap every branch option or active source poem in a drop-shadowed card box—use 1px hairline rows and tonal surface layering instead.
Don't repeat identical keyboard-hint copy on every branch row; place one quiet caption line beneath the branch list.
Don't dump recorded offline sessions as raw plain text with ASCII — Divider — lines or flex-gapped subword chips that break words like Camarón or duende apart.
Don't keep the top header sticky below 640px where wrapped controls would consume vertical reading height on mobile screens.
Don't introduce external build steps or CSS frameworks that break single-file standalone offline HTML export.
